# Cretli managed autostart v1
[Unit]
Description=Cretli supervisor
StartLimitBurst=5
StartLimitIntervalSec=600

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory="/home/user/my app"
ExecStart="/home/user/node install/bin/node" "/home/user/my app/scripts/cretli-supervisor.mjs"
Environment="PATH=/home/user/node install/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=45

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
warnings: Without --linger, autostart requires login. --linger explicitly permits loginctl enable-linger for this user (policy may refuse it; no sudo).
activation: Activation at next boot/login; use --apply --start to start explicitly.
